$comment: Games and apps that teach something by making him recall it, rendered under Games on /curio. Started 2026-09-26 from his ask: 'I'm interested in all this, but I don't want to lose it ... if there's more, you can just keep finding and adding them'. He leans free; paid only if it is good enough. Every url was fetched on 2026-09-27 and answered 200 with the right page title (Merlin and Seek point at Google Play because their own sites refuse non-browser requests). Artle (National Gallery of Art) was dropped because its page could not be confirmed. Within a group, the order is the order to try them in. `learn` and `do` render; keep each to a few words. `cost` is one of free | paid | free+paid. `site` overrides the domain the icon is taken from, for links that point at Google Play or GitHub rather than the app's own site.
